name: KromiumSecurity
summary: Facade for managing browser security rules such as host locking.

properties.name: hostLock
properties.description: Whitelist of allowed hostnames/domains. Navigations outside these domains will be rejected.

properties.name: hostLockSubresources
properties.description: When true, host lock also restricts subresource network requests (scripts, xhr, fetch).

properties.name: hostLockSubframes
properties.description: When true, host lock also restricts navigations in subframes (iframes). Defaults to false, allowing embedded verification widgets to navigate within iframes without violating host locking.
